comments.author: Nicola
comments.body:
To clear things up, you CANNOT change job in the middle of the ocean, much less in a battle.

Plus, you do need an endorsement, which makes this skill pretty useless in my opinion. You can always store a few endorsements in quarters/bank and pull them when needed in the carribean, but it's really a pain.

comments.author: Chester
comments.body:
It is useful in times like 2x when u are in EA. 15k credit is nothing when u are grinding next to a city with archive.

I usually carry endorsements for every major jobs, like cannoneer, swordmaster, guardian, muskeeteer, so that I can change jobs without having to go to calicut :)

comments.author: Curious
comments.body: When it says "change jobs" it means switch to another job-type. In other words, you can't switch from say, Fisher job to Ocean Explorer job because those are both adventure jobs.

comments.author: Juicebox
comments.body: You can change to any job you have the endorsement for if the endorsement is in your inventory.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: One new feature has been added to this skill: an option now exists to change Union affiliation along with your job. I don't believe you can finalize a Union change without also using up a job endorsement card from your inventory, but there is some worth to this if you were planning to change from a battle job to an adventure one, or vice versa, in a region without any guilds (such as East Asia).
